summary: The /manage re-request date grid took today from toLocaleDateString('en-CA', …) and string-sorted it against engine dates, so a browser whose en-CA short date isn't YYYY-MM-DD (CLDR 42 once changed it) would get a broken range.
fix: seasonOf moved to src/app/manage/_lib/season.ts and takes today from civilDateIn(now, TZ) (Intl's numeric parts in Vancouver), with the shared civil-day step.
